title: Neutral twin of the max-share predator trait (seed 1): the trait mosaic persists to t=3000, while the selective arm converges on a raised trait
summary: Same snapshot script as 20261028T1007-c64-fl-sampled-trait-snapshots (its snapt.py) on the neutral arm (trait read by nothing, same seed and mutation draws). At t=1000, 2000 and 3000 predator bodies carry mixed traits: pale, blue (log trait ~-0.4) and orange (~+0.3) bodies side by side (snap_s1_neu.png). The selective arm instead converges to light orange by t=2000 (snap_s1_sel.png, copied here). One seed; it agrees with the time series of 20261028T0953-c64-fl-sampled-trait-interim (seed 1: 0.27 vs 0.03).
